title: pn junction in equilibrium vs temperature: built-in potential and n p = n_i(T)^2 (analytic)
description:
The abrupt silicon pn junction of pn_junction_depletion (N_A = 1e23 1/m^3 for x < x_j, N_D = 2e23 beyond, eps_dc 11.7) in thermal equilibrium (both ohmic contacts at 0 V) at a lattice temperature T other than 300 K. The drift_diffusion temperature setting only sets V_T = k_B T / q; n_intrinsic does not follow it, so the material takes n_i(T) from a parameter: n_i(T) = n_i(300 K) (T / 300)^1.5 exp(-(q / 2 k_B)(E_g(T) / T - E_g(300) / 300)) with the Varshni gap E_g(T) = 1.17 - 4.73e-4 T^2 / (T + 636) eV (n_i 7.4e13 at 250 K, 1e16 at 300 K, 5.3e18 at 400 K). The sweep runs T over 250, 300, 350, 400 K.
Analytic (Boltzmann statistics, equilibrium): the neutral bulk potentials psi_n = V_T asinh(N_D / 2 n_i) and psi_p = -V_T asinh(N_A / 2 n_i), so V_bi = V_T (asinh(N_D / 2 n_i) + asinh(N_A / 2 n_i)) (0.92 V at 250 K to 0.70 V at 400 K); n p = n_i^2 in every cell (quasi-Fermi levels flat at 0 V), so the minority electron density of the p bulk is n_i^2 / p0 with p0 = N_A / 2 + sqrt(N_A^2 / 4 + n_i^2); junction field E_j = sqrt(2 q N_A N_D (V_bi - 2 V_T) / (eps (N_A + N_D))) (depletion approximation with the majority Debye-tail correction, as in pn_junction_depletion).
Derived values tab: psi_n_bulk / psi_p_bulk (mean V over 0.2 um of neutral n / p bulk), V_builtin (their difference as one mean over both regions), np_ratio (mean of N P / n_i^2 over the strip vs 1) and n_minority_p (mean N over the p bulk), all ~1e-6 (float32 stored fields; tolerance 1e-4, n_minority_p 1e-3); E_max (max of -E_x vs E_j minus q N_A dx / (2 eps), the cell-centre drop next to the junction, ~1e-3 as in pn_junction_depletion).
Sweep tab: V_builtin, n_minority_p (log axis: it spans eight decades) and E_max vs T with dashed curves.
Line profile tab (last sweep value, 400 K): phi_n_flat (electron quasi-Fermi potential along the strip, analytic 0 V: an absolute error in V) and V_profile (depletion-approximation potential, drawn only: it steps by V_T at each depletion edge, where the real potential has a Debye tail).

parameters.name: T_lat
parameters.description: lattice temperature in K (the semiconductor temperature setting; swept 250..400 K)

parameters.name: q_e
parameters.description: elementary charge in C

parameters.name: k_B
parameters.description: Boltzmann constant in J/K

parameters.name: V_T
parameters.description: thermal voltage in V

parameters.name: E_g0
parameters.description: silicon band gap at 0 K in eV (Varshni)

parameters.name: varshni_a
parameters.description: Varshni coefficient alpha in eV/K

parameters.name: varshni_b
parameters.description: Varshni coefficient beta in K

parameters.name: E_g
parameters.description: band gap at T_lat in eV

parameters.name: E_g300
parameters.description: band gap at 300 K in eV (1.125)

parameters.name: n_i300
parameters.description: intrinsic carrier density at 300 K in 1/m^3

parameters.name: n_i_T
parameters.description: intrinsic carrier density at T_lat in 1/m^3 (N_c N_v ~ T^3 and the Varshni gap)

parameters.name: eps_si
parameters.description: static relative permittivity of silicon

parameters.name: eps_s
parameters.description: static permittivity in F/m

parameters.name: N_A
parameters.description: acceptor density of the p side in 1/m^3

parameters.name: N_D
parameters.description: donor density of the n side in 1/m^3

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: strip length along x

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size (about 5 cells per Debye length)

parameters.name: Ly
parameters.description: strip height (two cells: a 1D problem)

parameters.name: x_j
parameters.description: metallurgical junction (a cell face)

parameters.name: w_contact
parameters.description: width of each ohmic contact at the strip ends

parameters.name: x_p0
parameters.description: start of the neutral p bulk region

parameters.name: x_n0
parameters.description: start of the neutral n bulk region

parameters.name: L_bulk
parameters.description: length of each bulk region (equal, so one mean over both gives their difference)

parameters.name: psi_p
parameters.description: neutral p-side potential -V_T asinh(N_A / 2 n_i) in V

parameters.name: psi_n
parameters.description: neutral n-side potential V_T asinh(N_D / 2 n_i) in V

parameters.name: V_bi
parameters.description: built-in potential in V

parameters.name: p0_p
parameters.description: hole density of the neutral p bulk in 1/m^3

parameters.name: n0_p
parameters.description: minority electron density of the neutral p bulk in 1/m^3

parameters.name: E_j
parameters.description: field magnitude at the junction in V/m

parameters.name: E_cell_ref
parameters.description: largest cell-centre field magnitude (the p-side cell next to the junction face)

parameters.name: x_dep_p
parameters.description: depletion width on the p side in m

parameters.name: x_dep_n
parameters.description: depletion width on the n side in m

analytic_curves.name: V_profile
analytic_curves.expression: where(x < x_j - x_dep_p, psi_p, where(x < x_j, psi_p + V_T + q_e*N_A*(x - x_j + x_dep_p)**2/(2*eps_s), where(x < x_j + x_dep_n, psi_n - V_T - q_e*N_D*(x_j + x_dep_n - x)**2/(2*eps_s), psi_n)))
